title: Waffle Hungerbar
description: Turn your Hungerbar into delicious Waffles!
body:
## WAFFLES
If you like Waffles, you'll love this Resource Pack!

Why have a boring Hungerbar when you could be eating Waffles!

Replace the Vanilla Hungerbar with some tasty Waffles!

![Waffle Hungerbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fab223a9e0d51fbea4a5e78b7af8e9eeab718295_0.webp)

What are you waiting for? Turn your Hungerbar into Waffles now!
